name: oracle-awr-analysis
description: Analyze Oracle AWR reports and identify performance bottlenecks, inefficient SQL, wait events and resource issues.
---

# Oracle AWR Analysis

When an AWR report is provided:

Analyze:

## Database Profile

- DB Time
- DB CPU
- Average Active Sessions

## Load Profile

Review:

- Transactions Per Second
- Logical Reads
- Physical Reads
- Parses

## Top Timed Events

Identify:

- CPU bottlenecks
- I/O bottlenecks
- Commit bottlenecks
- Concurrency bottlenecks

## SQL Statistics

Analyze:

- Elapsed Time
- CPU Time
- Buffer Gets
- Executions

## Findings

For each finding provide:

- Root Cause
- Recommendation
- Expected Gain

Classify impact:

Critical
High
Medium
Low

Generate Health Score (/100)
